cohort: 15,765 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants born between 2003 and 2008 at less than 34 weeks of gestation and weighing less than 1,500 g at birth
finding: This study confirms that antenatal corticosteroid (ACS) treatment is associated with decreases in infant mortality and severe morbidity in VLBW infants.
mod_finding: The study also found that mode of delivery may be associated with severe morbidity in VLBW infants exposed to ACS, with cesarean section deliveries associated with lower IVH and ROP but higher chronic lung disease, and vaginal deliveries associated with lower RDS but higher NEC and chronic lung disease.
